gloss: lowest score; lowest point; minimum mark

definitions.gloss: lowest score; worst mark; minimum points
definitions.explanation: The worst or lowest score achieved in a test, competition, or evaluation.
The figuratively or physically lowest point of something, such as the low point of a career, economy, or terrain.

examples.japanese: {最低点|さいていてん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧30⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧だった。
⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧{最低点|さいていてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}かなかった→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: I didn't reach the minimum passing score.

examples.japanese: {今学期|こんがっき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数学|すうがく}→数学：01442_suugaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最低点|さいていてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧しまい、⟦{落|お}ち{込|こ}んだ→落ち込む：05750_ochikomu⟧。
examples.english: I got the lowest math score this semester and felt down.

examples.japanese: ⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{最低点|さいていてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}った→打つ：01221_utsu⟧。
⟦{支持率|しじりつ}→支持率：17086_shijiritsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{最低点|さいていてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}した→更新する：27994_koushinsuru⟧。
examples.english: The approval rating reached a new low.

examples.english: The experience of climbing back up from the lowest point in my life made me who I am today.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{最低|さいてい}→最低：01412_saitei⟧ (lowest; worst) and ⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧ (point; score). In academic contexts, ⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧{最低点|さいていてん} (minimum passing score) is an especially important compound, as Japanese entrance exams often publish this figure.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧{最低点|さいていてん}: minimum passing score
- {最低点|さいていてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to get the lowest score
- {最低点|さいていてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧: to hit the lowest point
- {最低点|さいていてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}する→更新する：27994_koushinsuru⟧: to reach a new low

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{最高点|さいこうてん}→最高点：25791_saikouten⟧: highest score/point — the opposite
- {底値|そこね}: rock-bottom price — specifically about prices
- ⟦{最低|さいてい}→最低：01412_saitei⟧: lowest; worst — the broader adjective/noun
